description: Single-instance 3F offer, API-view, backlog, and redeem execution dashboard. This deployment is scoped to the opportunity execution lane and its independent signer/RPC/txmanager. Native Grafana Dashboard Schema v2 delivery; Prometheus queries are scoped by namespace, kubernetes_pod, job, and instance. Requires vault-solver metrics commit d5f5385e or a descendant.

spec.title: View freshness
spec.description: Age of each independent retained API view.

spec.title: Activity and backlog ages
spec.description: Comparable process-local ages; zero means no continuous backlog or activity observed.

spec.title: Offer submission counts
spec.description: Accepted and failed API submissions over time.

spec.title: Accepted offer amounts
spec.description: Principal and expected-yield atomic units remain separated by token.

spec.title: API operation p95
spec.description: Latency trend for each fixed 3F API operation.

spec.title: Request backlog trend
spec.description: Outstanding exposure and immediately redeemable work over time.

spec.title: Redeem transaction outcomes
spec.description: Exact terminal txmanager outcomes over the selected range.

spec.title: Execution cost
spec.description: Receipt-backed transaction count, gas, and native fee over the selected range.

spec.title: Current view counts
spec.description: Current authoritative target, offer, request, and redeemable counts.
